title: US midterm elections: what is at stake tomorrow
caption:
Americans vote tomorrow in midterm elections that will decide control of Congress. All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats are up, and Republicans currently hold both chambers. Polls show Democrats ahead nationally, but the Senate will be decided in a few close races. First results are expected on Tuesday evening.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
